# `oaap app link`

app-to-app links (RFC-0016).

**Root:** needs `sudo`.

## Usage

```sh
oaap app link {add,remove,list} [source] [target]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `action` | what to do -- see Actions below |
| `source` | the instance that may reach the target |
| `target` | the instance it may reach |

## Actions

Whether an action needs `sudo` is read from the rule the node enforces, with the other arguments left out (e.g. `node care` reads, `node care measure` needs `sudo`).

| Action | Needs `sudo` |
|---|---|
| `add` | yes |
| `remove` | yes |
| `list` | yes |
